0022600211.text: The Knicks (5-4, 3rd in the Atlantic) host the Milwaukee Bucks (1-9, 5th in the Central) on a three-game winning streak, while Milwaukee has dropped six straight and is 1-5 at home. Josh Hart (ankle) and Tyler Herro (knee bruise) are both day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Knicks won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 127-98 road win in Milwaukee on February 27, 2026.
